title: Issue with ais-dynamic-widgets and ais-hierarchical-menu in Vue3
body: ### 🐛 Current behavior We are trying to use `ais-dynamic-widgets` in combination with `ais-hierarchical-menu` using the following versions: * `algoliasearch`: `4.12.1` * `vue`: `3.2.25` * `vue-instantsearch`: `4.19.4` The `ais-hierarchical-menu` works perfectly on its own. However, when placed inside the `ais-dynamic-widgets`, nothing is rendered within the dynamic widget.
